FLEX

Closing this window keeps FLEX running in the tray. Use the tray icon's menu to quit.

Movie folders

    TV show folders

    Everything inside a TV folder is an episode. Each show gets its own subfolder (e.g. TV Shows\Futurama\Season 3\…); season folders are optional. Don't add a TV folder to the movie list as well.

      Player

      The full-screen player shows this PC's library (and the other FLEX PCs') on a TV: the keyboard, a remote or a game controller moves around, C casts to a Chromecast, Q or Alt+F4 leaves. 4K and HEVC play as they are when this PC can decode them (HEVC needs Microsoft's "HEVC Video Extensions"); the rest is converted by the PC that has the file.

      Server

      Home screen

      The AI sorts your library into Netflix-style rows (the time of year first, then moods, decades, series…) about once a week. Only titles, years and genres are sent. Each refresh is one request billed to your account with that provider; with Claude it is roughly $0.30. With more than one FLEX PC a key on one of them is enough: the others show its rows.

      Season prep

      The AI's row for the holiday or season (Home screen above) picks this PC's SD titles; FLEX upscales them to 1080p one at a time while nobody is watching, the PS5 then plays those files directly, and they are removed once the season is over. Titles you add here stay until you remove them. With Topaz Video AI installed on this PC, its own upscaler does the work; otherwise the built-in AI shaders do.

        Other FLEX PCs

        Each FLEX PC lists the others' libraries next to its own, so the PS5, browsers and phones see everything whichever PC they reach. A movie plays from the PC that has the file, converted by that PC's GPU. That PC has to be on.

        Remote access (Tailscale)

        FLEX joins your tailnet as its own device. Phones and laptops with Tailscale can then open it from anywhere; a PS5 needs a travel router on your tailnet (see docs/remote.md).

        Off
        Advanced: auth key instead of signing in

        PS5

        Payloads don't survive a console restart. When a PS5 that has used FLEX is jailbroken again (elfldr on port 9021) but its Homebrew Launcher (websrv) isn't running, FLEX sends websrv to it so the launcher tile works again.
